name: equipment-record
title: Pressure equipment record
for_each: select id,code from equipment where status<>'retired' order by code

sections.title: Item
sections.sql: select r.code,r.site,r.name,r.kind,r.hazard_level,r.fluid,r.design_pressure_kpa,e.design_temp_c,e.manufacturer,e.serial_no,e.year_built,e.design_registration,e.item_registration,r.status from v_register r join equipment e on e.id=r.equipment_id where r.equipment_id=$1

sections.title: Inspection history
sections.sql: select code,kind,done_on,result,inspector,report_ref,findings from inspections where equipment_id=$1 order by done_on desc

sections.title: Thickness monitoring
sections.sql: select cml,location,last_on,last_mm,required_mm,rate_mm_yr,remaining_life_yrs from v_cml_rates where equipment_id=$1 order by cml

sections.title: Relief devices
sections.sql: select v.valve,v.set_pressure_kpa,v.last_tested,v.last_result,v.next_due from v_valves v where v.valve_id in (select id from relief_valves where equipment_id=$1) order by v.valve

name: remaining-life-report
title: Remaining life assessment
for_each: select distinct e.id,e.code from equipment e join cmls c on c.equipment_id=e.id where e.status<>'retired' order by e.code

sections.title: Monitoring points
sections.note: Rates in mm a year. The higher of the long term and short term rate governs. Next internal is no later than half the remaining life or ten years (API 510 6.5.1.1).
sections.sql: select cml,location,nominal_mm,required_mm,first_on,first_mm,last_on,last_mm,long_term_mm_yr,short_term_mm_yr,governs,remaining_life_yrs from v_cml_rates where equipment_id=$1 order by cml

sections.title: Readings
sections.sql: select c.code cml,r.measured_on,r.thickness_mm from readings r join cmls c on c.id=r.cml_id where c.equipment_id=$1 order by c.code,r.measured_on

name: relief-valve-register
title: Relief valve register
for_each: select id,code from sites order by code

sections.title: Site
sections.sql: select code,name,country,inspection_body from sites where id=$1

sections.title: Valves
sections.sql: select v.valve,v.equipment,v.set_pressure_kpa,v.design_pressure_kpa,v.service,v.interval_months,v.last_tested,v.last_pop_kpa,v.last_result,v.next_due,v.status from v_valves v where v.site=(select code from sites where id=$1) order by v.valve

name: anomaly-report
title: Anomaly report
for_each: select id,code from anomalies where closed_on is null order by code

sections.title: Finding
sections.sql: select a.code,e.code equipment,e.name,a.severity,a.raised_on,a.description,a.due_on,i.code inspection,i.report_ref from anomalies a join equipment e on e.id=a.equipment_id left join inspections i on i.id=a.inspection_id where a.id=$1

sections.title: Close-out
sections.note: Close against the work order or report that fixed it.
sections.sql: select coalesce(closed_ref,'Open') reference,closed_on from anomalies where id=$1

name: certificate-schedule
title: Certificate of inspection schedule
for_each: select id,code from sites order by code

sections.title: Site
sections.sql: select code,name,country,inspection_body from sites where id=$1

sections.title: Certificates
sections.sql: select c.equipment,c.cert_no,c.issued_on,c.expires_on,c.days_left,c.issued_by,c.conditions from v_certificates c join equipment e on e.id=c.equipment_id where e.site_id=$1 and e.status<>'retired' order by c.expires_on

sections.title: In service without a certificate
sections.sql: select e.code,e.name,e.hazard_level from equipment e where e.site_id=$1 and e.status='in_service' and not exists (select 1 from certificates c where c.equipment_id=e.id) order by e.code
